observed_deltas.finding: VCFv4.2 adds * as an ALT allele for an allele missing due to an upstream deletion; VCFv4.1's ALT definition does not contain this option.

Both versions describe / and | as genotype-level unphased/phased separators. Both specify the diploid triangular GL ordering formula, with diploidy assumed when GT is absent. VCFv4.1 and 4.2 also include GLE for heterogeneous ploidy; this is not the same as arbitrary-ploidy canonical Number=G ordering.

Both versions describe clonal derivation with PEDIGREE=<Derived=ID2,Original=ID1>, family trio relationships using Child/Mother/Father, and a general Name_0=G0-ID,...,Name_N=GN-ID form. The general form defines Name_0 as derived from N>=1 ancestor genomes.
VCFv4.3 replaces the diploid-only closed-form description with general ploidy P ordering pseudocode and an index formula; the source introduces a general combinatorial ordering model.

VCFv4.3 introduces explicit Number/Type reserved INFO and FORMAT tables and moves structural-variant definitions into a reorganized source. The table formalization must not be projected back into 4.1/4.2 prose lists.

VCFv4.3 changes the PEDIGREE syntax to ID=DerivedID,Original=OriginalID and ID=SampleID,Name_1=Ancestor1,...,Name_N=AncestorN. The clonal and multiple-ancestor semantics persist, but header key layout changes.

VCFv4.3 explicitly defines uppercase percent-escape codes for reserved delimiters and control characters. The corresponding specific escape-code rules are absent from VCFv4.1 and VCFv4.2 and must not be back-projected.

VCFv4.4 changes GT to allele-level phasing indicators: an allele is preceded by its phasing indicator, and the first indicator may be omitted and inferred from the remaining indicators. This is not identical to the earlier genotype-level separator description.
VCFv4.4 revises SV fields to support multiple symbolic ALT alleles with per-ALT Number=A or paired Number=. vectors; INFO SVLEN becomes Number=A and CIPOS/CIEND become ALT-paired offset lists.
VCFv4.4 disallows symbolic BND ALT records; the change log explicitly directs breakpoint representation to breakend replacement notation. Earlier 4.1-4.3 examples and definitions include SVTYPE=BND.
VCFv4.4 adds tandem-repeat <CNV:TR> fields and SVCLAIM semantics, EVENTTYPE, and PSL/PSO/PSQ support for derivative-chromosome reconstruction; these are not 4.3 requirements.
VCFv4.4 changes INFO CN to allele-specific copy number and FORMAT CN to sample total copy number, including non-integer values; 4.3 uses earlier segment/breakend-oriented copy-number descriptions.
VCFv4.4 retains the VCFv4.3 ID=SampleID PEDIGREE syntax and the haplotype uniqueness/conservation and duplication semantics; source text is moved to the corresponding 4.4 section.
VCFv4.4 retains the VCFv4.3 uppercase percent-escape code set for colon, semicolon, equals, percent, comma, CR, LF and horizontal tab.

normative_source_locators.from: VCFv4.4.tex: FORMAT Number definitions and reserved FORMAT table
normative_source_locators.finding: VCFv4.5 adds LA/LR/LG local-allele cardinalities, P cardinality by genotype allele values, and M cardinality by possible base modifications.

normative_source_locators.from: VCFv4.4.tex: reserved FORMAT inventory; no M/DPM/ADM family
normative_source_locators.finding: VCFv4.5 reserves M[0-9]+[ACGTUN], DPM[0-9]+[ACGTUN] and ADM[0-9]+[ACGTUN], defines ChEBI-linked semantics, aliases, GT dependency, allele/base order, strand handling, missing/symbolic-allele behavior and unstranded storage conventions.

normative_source_locators.from: VCFv4.4.tex: reserved FORMAT inventory; no LAA/local-equivalent family
normative_source_locators.finding: VCFv4.5 introduces LAA and local equivalents LAD/LADF/LADR/LEC/LGL/LGP/LPL/LPP; LAA is a distinct 1-based ALT index list and is required when local-allele fields are populated. Local/global equivalents must encode identical information when both are present, subject to missing/omitted representation.

normative_source_locators.from: VCFv4.4.tex: prior Number and genotype semantics
normative_source_locators.finding: VCFv4.5 adds Number=P for fields with one value per allele value defined in GT; this is distinct from the older Number=G genotype-combination cardinality.

normative_source_locators.topic: INFO END lifecycle and computed semantics
normative_source_locators.from: VCFv4.4.tex:703 and prior symbolic-allele END usage
normative_source_locators.finding: VCFv4.5 deprecates INFO END in favor of SVLEN and FORMAT LEN, while defining END as a computed compatibility field derived from the maximum applicable REF, symbolic-SV/SVLEN and <*>/FORMAT-LEN end positions; computed END contributes to BCF rlen and indexing behavior.

VCFv4.5 adds FORMAT LEN for sample-specific <*> reference-block lengths, allows reference-only blocks using <*> and LEN, and specifies backward-compatible NON_REF alias and LEN inference from INFO END. Preserve gVCF producer convention provenance separately from core VCF normative text.
VCFv4.5 marks SVTYPE deprecated as redundant with symbolic ALT definitions and directs readers to the ALT field symbolic structural-variant set.

normative_source_locators.finding: VCFv4.5 retains the prefix/allele-level phasing representation introduced in 4.4; it must not be collapsed into the earlier genotype-level separator model. Exact 4.4-to-4.5 change status requires a line-by-line equality/delta check.
